limitations.note: The patch fixed the one-cycle delay in `match` but also changed two exits from `s4_d0110` to retain the final zero for overlapping matches, whereas the correct fix leaves those exits unchanged.
The exhaustive test used a sliding-window oracle that expected overlapping matches, so it confirmed the agent’s assumption rather than checking that the original post-match behavior was preserved.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation invocation to be rejected before it ran, forcing the agent to resubmit the same test with different cleanup.
